youtube.title: Why Your Windshield Has Black Dots 🚗 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Those rows of black dots around a windshield are part of a ceramic band called the frit, baked into the glass. The solid black band hides and shields the adhesive that holds the windshield in place, because ultraviolet light breaks that adhesive down over time. The dots shrink toward the clear glass, blending the band's edge so the glass heats more evenly and looks less harsh.
